metadata.description: Preliminary Cursor plugins that organize skills for Chad's Grok Bot team and the cloud agents it launches.

plugins.name: bot-skills

plugins.name: coding-skills

plugins.name: personal-skills
plugins.description: Skills for Chad's personal bots only: complex feature workflow, idea card enrichment, leadership briefs, activity reports, expense reports, and bot retrospectives.
